newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Wrightson reaffirms NZ$24-7 mln profit forecast.
newsitem.headline: Wrightson reaffirms NZ$24-7 mln profit forecast.

text.p: New Zealand rural services company Wrightson Group on Friday reaffirmed its June forecast of NZ$24-27 million net profit in "difficult trading conditions" for the year to June 30, 1997.
The company earlier announced a 1995-96 net profit of $1.14 million. Before restructuring costs, it said profit fell to NZ$19.3 million from $23.6 million a year earlier.
The final dividend of seven cents makes a total 10.5 cents for the year, fully imputed, or 92 percent of the pre-restructuring profit.
Wrightson Farmers Finance performed strongly, raising net profit by 18 percent to $7.5 million in the face of strong competition from trading banks.

Trotter said good progress had been made with Wrightson's "transformation" programme and it was on track to achieve expected cost efficiencies and revenue growth from the six new operating divisions established on July 1.
He restated the dividend policy of paying out 60 percent to 80 percent of tax-paid profit to shareholders.
Total div for yr (cents) 10.5 vs same
Note - Wrightson Ltd is a stock and station agent/rural services group.
